sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Prince Singh,Bishlendra Prasad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Prince Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Manish Kumar Pandey the learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
171 of 2022, under Sections 328, 354(Ga), 376, 386, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Mahanagar, District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 22.06.2022 alleging that the applicant kept on physically and mentally exploiting the informant for the past two years under an allurement of getting her employed and he clicked obscene photos and videos of the informant and sent the same on the mobile of the informant's son-in-law.

4. In the statement of the informant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she reiterated the F.I.R versions but in the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C, she stated that she has not seen the alleged obscene photos and videos and she had been told about the same by her daughter.
The informant's daughter stated that she does not have any video as alleged.

sentences.text: informant's son-in-law has not been recorded by the Investigating Officer.
5. In the medico legal examination report of the informant, no injury or sign of use of force and no abnormality has been reported.
6. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

7. Sri Manish Kumar Pandey, the learned A.G.A.-I has opposed the bail application, on the basis of the instruction, he stated that the allegation of photos and videos could not be supported by any material collected during instructions.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the incident is stated to have continued for two years, that the informant is an aged lady having married daughter; that the allegation of black-mail under threat of spreading photos and videos of the informant virally has not been supported by any material collected during investigation and coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 23.06.2022 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 19.5.2023 Preeti.
